name: Harmonic Picks
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: Choose a deck and find USB tracks with compatible keys and pitch changes within 6% of its live BPM.
description: Emulator preview. Tap PICKS in the WAVEFORM title area to open suggestions; Close or BACK returns. Choose your reference deck manually. Matches compatible library keys and live BPM within +/-6% required pitch; labels half/double time. Tap All tracks/Acapellas to filter; Previous/Next or knob to scroll; knob press changes filter. Suggestions only: no track loading. Keys do not follow Key Shift. Reload mods after changing USB libraries. Mod Menu > Harmonic Picks also opens the page. Disable the shortcut with PICKS waveform button.
